articles.title: 'Scary!' MAGA meltdown erupts as young man states fact to Erika Kirk in church
articles.description: A MAGA meltdown erupted online Saturday because a young man stated a fact to Erika Kirk in church. The supposed infiltration occurred Friday night as Kirk spoke at the Pursuit Church in Kirkland, Washington, as part of her "Make Heaven Crowded" tour event — and was interrupted by the shouts of a young man who rose to his feet. "You married Charlie Kirk," he cried out. Video then shows the young man being dragged away and handcuffed by heavy security. The X account Frontlines TPUSA, which is affiliated with the Kirk-led Turning Point USA , described it as a "scary moment," despite the young man being the only one standing up and shouting the one line. According to the account, "A far-left activist infiltrated" the event. Jonathan Choe , who recorded the video posted by Frontlines TPUSA, asked the young man what he wanted to say to Erika Kirk, but he mostly remained silent, only saying, "The things she supports is offensive." Kirk took the reins at TPUSA following the assassination of her husband Charlie Kirk at a Utah University speaking event on Sept. 10, 2025. Earlier this year, students successfully got their Phoenix high school to pull the plug on her planned on-campus event because they found her views " too extremist ." Her husband's violent death complicated the legacy as a MAGA influencer who made a career promoting what the Congressional Black Caucus Black Caucus has condemned as “racist, harmful, and fundamentally un-American” ideals. Choe described the events on his own account by writing , "Unhinged whacko went on a tirade" and "he got owned real fast." Meanwhile, other MAGA accounts agreed , "It was scary," while others praised Kirk for continuing. Some accounts questioned the description. Seattle-based journalist Hannah Krieg asked "what infiltrate means" here, as "It was a publicly advertised event with no screening process." Writer Matthew Boedy agreed, noting, "Interesting use of 'infiltrated.' Isn't this a tour to evangelize? Don't want people like this?" The event was also met with protesters who marched outside the church. MAGA commentators similarly went after them, with radio show host Jason Rantz calling them "wicked, evil monsters" in an X post .

articles.title: 3 more terrorists killed in Mastung IBO, taking tally to 13: state media
articles.description: Security forces have killed three more terrorists in an ongoing intelligence-based operation (IBO) in the Khad Kocha area of Balochistan’s Mastung district, state-run Radio Pakistan reported on Saturday, citing security sources. The security operation , conducted under an indefinite curfew , was launched after a shooting on a Karachi-bound coach coming from Quetta claimed three lives and injured five others on Wednesday. On Saturday, Radio Pakistan quoted security sources as saying that “Fitna al-Hindustan has suffered further losses” in the IBO, which has been dubbed Operation Al-Azm. The government uses the term “ Fitna al-Hindustan ” for Balochistan-based groups to highlight India’s alleged role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan. “The number of terrorists killed so far during Operation Al-Azm has reached 13,” Radio Pakistan reported. Six of these had been killed on Thursday and another four were eliminated a day ago. Security sources said that several hideouts “belonging to Fitna al-Hindustan ” were destroyed. They added that weapons, ammunition and materials used for making improvised explosive devices (IEDs) were also recovered. “There are also confirmed reports that several terrorists belonging to Fitna ul Hindustan were injured during the operation,” Radio Pakistan stated. On Thursday , besides six terrorists being killed, officials also claimed the arrest of female suicide bombers and several other suspects who were considered to be working as facilitators for the attackers. The same day, District and Sessions Judge Abdul Hakeem Kakar and his guard were gunned down , and another judge was among two injured when they came under attack by armed men while heading to Mastung. The gun attack followed security forces killing three terrorists in Mastung, where the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said two suicide bombers and their facilitator were also apprehended. Another seven terrorists were eliminated in Surab district. Amid the clearance operation in Mastung, the provincial leadership on Friday emphasised the need for a political resolution to the ongoing crisis. Speaking to political and tribal leaders, Balochistan Home Minister Mir Ziaullah Langove reiterated the government’s commitment to dialogue and said the parliament remained the most effective platform for political parties to present their views, concerns and demands. Security concerns have heightened in Balochistan after a spate of major terrorist attacks took place earlier this month, which prompted counterterrorism operations across the province. Among the counterterrorism efforts was Operation Shaban , in which 91 terrorists were killed between July 5 and July 16, according to security sources cited by state media. This took the tally of terrorists eliminated in operations across the province during the period to 129.
